description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementService class within the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It manages leave entitlement operations such as calculating balances, adding entitlements, and deleting entitlements, integrating with various traits and DAOs for leave management functionalities.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing leave entitlements, including retrieving balances, adding, deleting, and bulk assigning leave entitlements, interfacing with DAOs and strategies to perform business logic.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the leave entitlement consumption strategy, which can be FIFO or other strategies based on configuration.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the DAO object for leave entitlement database operations.

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Returns a list of entitlement IDs that can be deleted, filtering based on whether each entitlement is deemed deletable.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Determines if a given LeaveEntitlement object is eligible for deletion, based on whether it has been used.

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and retrieves the leave balance for an employee for a specific leave type as of a certain date.

methods.name: addEntitlementForEmployee
methods.description: Adds or updates leave entitlement for an employee within a specific period, handling both creation and updating existing entitlements.

methods.name: bulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Assigns leave entitlements en masse to multiple employees for a given leave type and period, returning the list of created entitlements.
